title: Chief Executive Officer - Gloucester, Massachusetts (US) job with Gloucester Marine Geonomics Institute (GMGI) | 12865154
gist: Gloucester Marine Genomics Institute (GMGI), a Massachusetts nonprofit, is recruiting a PhD-level CEO at $275,000-$350,000 to lead its next growth phase, expanding from marine genomics into applied and translational research in immunology, biotechnology, neuroscience, cancer biology and bioinformatics.

themes.theme: GMGI strategic pivot to translational research

insights.claim: Gloucester Marine Genomics Institute (GMGI) says that after establishing a marine sciences research portfolio it is poised to expand into applied marine science and translational areas including immunology, biotechnology, neuroscience, cancer biology and bioinformatics.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Signals a small nonprofit research institute repositioning toward commercially adjacent biotech fields, a potential source of early-stage partnerships or spinouts.
insights.quote: GMGI is now poised to expand its research profile with a focus on applied marine science and translational opportunities

insights.claim: GMGI frames its genomics-driven marine research as having translational applications in environmental resilience, biotechnology innovation and human health.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Marine genomics is being pitched as a discovery engine for biotech and health applications, not just ecology.
insights.quote: exploring translational applications that can improve environmental resilience, biotechnology innovation and human health

insights.claim: GMGI is offering a $275,000-$350,000 annual salary range for its Chief Executive Officer role in Gloucester, Massachusetts, with applications closing 28 Dec 2026.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Provides a benchmark for executive pay at small nonprofit life-science research institutes.
insights.quote: $275,000-$350,000 Annual Salary Range with competitive benefits package

insights.claim: GMGI's CEO candidate profile emphasizes internationally recognized scientific achievement and demonstrated success securing competitive research funding, indicating fundraising capacity is central to the institute's growth plan.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Nonprofit research growth hinges on grant and competitive funding access, making the leader's fundraising record a key driver.
insights.quote: Demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding

insights.claim: GMGI runs the Gloucester Biotechnology Academy, a workforce training program that trains recent high school graduates for careers as life sciences lab technicians.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Non-degree technician pipelines are one response to life-sciences labor needs in the Massachusetts biotech cluster.
insights.quote: trains recent high school graduates for successful careers as life sciences lab technicians
insights.locator: GMGI combines this thriving research institute
